question_text: What was the peak head_count observed at DemoBooth_NVIDIA on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?

gold.sql: SELECT MAX(head_count) AS peak FROM events WHERE event_type = 'crowd' AND camera_location = 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA' AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.note: Single MAX aggregate over a crowd-mode camera's day.
